description_en: Creates a feature consistency check job
description_zh: 创建特征一致性检查任务
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice create-feature-consistency-check-job --instance-id pairec-cn-00000000 --feature-consistency-check-job-config-id 3 --environment Pre --sampling-duration 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFeatureConsistencyCheckJob

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID on the [Instances](~~2411819~~) page.
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html page
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The feature consistency check job configuration ID. You can call the [ListFeatureConsistencyCheckJobConfigs](~~2557567~~) operation to obtain this ID.
parameters.description_zh: 特征一致性检查任务配置ID。如何获取配置ID，请参见[ListFeatureConsistencyCheckJobConfigs](~~2557567~~)。
parameters.help_en: The feature consistency check job configuration ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557567.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 特征一致性检查任务配置ID。如何获取配置ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557567.html
parameters.name: feature_consistency_check_job_config_id

parameters.description_en:
The environment where the job runs. Valid values:

- Daily: the daily environment

- Pre: the pre-production environment

- Prod: the production environment
parameters.description_zh:
运行环境：
- Daily：日常环境
- Pre：预发环境
- Prod：生产环境
parameters.help_en:
